requirement: Invoices must be payable within 30 days (Net 30) or longer. Payment windows shorter than 30 days (such as Net 15 or due upon receipt) violate company cash-flow policy.
Total aggregate liability must be capped (typically at 12 months of fees paid). Unlimited liability for general breach of contract is a FAIL.
If the contract automatically renews, the customer must be allowed to cancel with no more than 30 to 60 days written notice prior to renewal.
Vendor must notify the customer of any security breach or unauthorized data access within 72 hours (or 3 business days) of discovery.
